name: Thomas Boyle
bioAdditions: Thomas A. Boyle, born 7 Nov 1866 in Ireland, was a miner in Hazle Township. He married Theresa Meier at Hazleton on 28 Oct 1896 (licence No. 21146, Rev. E. W. Fitzmaurice) (S1). FamilySearch attaches the later marriage of their daughter Catharine to Jacob W. Kemmerer (S2).
